lines: Yes, Trigger.dev is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Visit our Security Portal for more information. Our latest report is available upon request for our Enterprise customers.
Yes, Trigger.dev is GDPR compliant. Visit our Security Portal for more information, or contact us to request data deletion.

Yes. Trigger.dev meets HIPAA Business Associate requirements. To run tasks that process PHI on Trigger.dev Cloud you'll need a signed BAA with us, which is available as a $500/month add-on. Request a BAA or view the full set of controls on our Security Portal .
Where can I find your list of sub-processors?
You can find our list of our active sub-processors on our Sub-processors page.
Can I view Trigger.dev's Data Processing Agreement?
Yes, our Data Processing Agreement is formed as part of our Terms of Service and applies automatically upon sign-up.
